specialist_trace.rationale: The chart contains contradictory severity assessments for the COPD exacerbation (severe on admission, mild in progress notes, moderate at discharge), which must be resolved by the treating clinician to establish a single, definitive severity level. Please clarify the patient’s actual clinical status at the time of the exacerbation—specifically, whether respiratory acidosis (PaCO2 56) and hypoxemia (PaO2 70) were present during the acute episode, and whether the patient required intensive therapy (e.g., non-invasive ventilation) or had a stable, mild course. This reconciliation is essential to ensure accurate coding and reflect the true acuity of the episode.
